name: Kabe ni Hamatte Ugokenai! 3 Shougeki Eizou Kandou no Kyuushutsu Geki
original_name: 壁にはまってうごけない!3 衝撃映像感動の救出劇
source:
Suzuno Shiraishi is an honest and bright girl, but a little timid.
When she tried to take a shortcut, she got stuck in a hole.
But instead of helping the men passing by, she ends up doing this and that...
　
In the end, rescue teams and TV stations were rushed to the scene.
And a forbidden development
